The '''Dueling Pits''' were a training ground operated by [[The Crucible]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] organization, where countless prisoners were kept and forced to fight each other in combat. The Pits were a moving location, constantly being transferred between [[Planet/Legends|planets]] on the Crucible's vessels.
